# Artwork sources

`lotf-icon.png` is the transparent Steam launcher icon installed for
*Lords of the Fallen* App ID 1501750. The identical PNG is packaged at
`worlds/lotf/assets/lotf-icon.png` for Archipelago Launcher.

Other-game pickups use the separate transparent Archipelago mark at
`game-mod/LotFArchipelago/Assets/archipelago.png`.

The images identify the supported game and multiworld integration in an
unofficial fan project. Game and Archipelago artwork and trademarks remain the
property of their respective owners.
